sections.A: Kalai ke paas radius haddi ka fracture bohat aam hai, khaas kar osteoporosis wali bari umar ki khawateen mein haath ke bal girne se.
sections.B: Plaster ke baad kalai aur forearm akde hue (khaas kar supination aur extension), ungliyan akdi, grip kamzor.
sections.C: Kaise ilaaj hua, plaster kab utra ya surgery kab hui, aur kya jalan wala dard, rang ya garmi ki tabdeeli hai (CRPS).
sections.D: Sujan, rang aur paseena dekhein, mutthi, kalai aur forearm ki range aur grip napein.
sections.E: CRPS ke liye Budapest criteria aur nerve aur tendon ke complications screen karein.
sections.F: Plaster mein tezi se sujan, sunn-pan aur shadeed dard (emergency), aur CRPS, angoothe ka tendon phatna aur haddi ka dobara khisakna (urgent).
sections.H: Surgeon ki hidayat aur healing phase dekhein, complications screen karein, phir phase ke mutabiq exercise.
sections.I: Haddi judne ke baad akdan rahe to kalai ke joints aur forearm ke jor ki glides.
sections.J: Plaster mein ungliyan, angootha, kohni aur kandha chalte rahein. Plaster utarne ke baad active range, phir taaqat.
sections.K: Akdan mein exercise se pehle garmi. Splint support ya stretch ke liye.
sections.L: Kalai aur forearm ki range, grip aur PRWE track karein. Bari umar ke patients ko haddiyon ki sehat aur girne se bachao ke liye refer karein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Plaster ke dauraan ungliyan hilana zaroori hai taa ke akdan aur sujan na ho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
